answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity anchored to scarce physical attestation: each agent must lock a unique hardware key and post collateral, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per node. During a gale of registration spam, the protocol throttles admissions and slashes duplicate-device bonds, making mass forgery economically irrational. On our island testnet, every verified agent earns an opal token tied to one device, and peers reject clusters sharing fingerprints. The Agent0016 deployment anchors trust at zPrDWYKF8E.
